foothold_candidates — DRIVE walkterrain op

• Data kinds: depth → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.foothold_candidates(grid, cell: 'float' = 0.05, window: 'int' = 3, min_score: 'float' = 0.6, min_dist: 'float' = 0.15, max_n: 'int' = 50, extent=None) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import terrain; terrain.foothold_candidates(grid, cell: 'float' = 0.05, window: 'int' = 3, min_score: 'float' = 0.6, min_dist: 'float' = 0.15, max_n: 'int' = 50, extent=None), registry से लेना हो तो opsdrive.get("foothold_candidates"))

• GPU: नहीं (केवल CPU reference implementation)

उपयोग

Terrain से अलग-अलग सुरक्षित कदम रखने के लक्ष्य चुनता है।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Scores every cell with foothold_score, keeps local maxima above *min_score*, and greedily suppresses candidates within *min_dist* (world units) of a better one — turning the continuous flatness field into a short list of "here are places you may put a foot". Returns a list of dicts sorted best-first, each with cell (row, col), score, and xy (world) when *extent* is given. The actionable output a foot-placement planner consumes.
